svg.aria-label: Flyer made of low-poly triangles: Polygon Evolution, a genetic algorithm that paints with translucent polygons. On the canvas, a few translucent triangles shift and multiply generation by generation while the counter climbs to 5000 and the Delta E error shrinks. Scored with CIE76 Delta E, SSIM, LPIPS and FID.

g.text: A genetic algorithm that paints with translucent polygons.
